## Change Type

- [ ] Feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Fix (`fix`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)
- [ ] Refactor (`refactor`)
- [ ] Test (`test`)
- [ ] CI/CD or Build (`ci`, `build`)

## Validation Checklist

- [ ] `git diff --check` passes cleanly
- [ ] Backend tests pass: `make test-backend` (all tests passing)
- [ ] Mobile tests pass: `make test-mobile` (all tests passing)
- [ ] Static analysis passes: `make analyze` (0 errors, 0 warnings)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, keys, or credentials committed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`

## Pedagogical & Safety Verification

- [ ] Explanations and tutor responses are strictly grounded in Grade 7 textbook content
- [ ] Citations include unit number and textbook page reference
